cast_contract.presence: true -> empty attribute value; false -> omission
cast_contract.integer: int signed; non-negative rejects negative; positive rejects zero and negative
cast_contract.float: public decimal display; positive rejects non-positive/non-finite according to existing cast
cast_contract.enum: only declared strings; unions try only declared branches
cast_contract.list: preserve order and duplicates; declared separator; comma adds following space; shorthand only where declared; item containing separator is error
cast_contract.datetime: date YYYY-MM-DD; time HH:MM[:SS]; combined YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS]
cast_contract.duration: nonzero parts Nw Nd Nh Nm Ns in order; zero 0s
cast_contract.image_candidate: dict src required plus at most one of positive width or positive density; SRC, SRC Nw or SRC Nd; empty/comma-edge src invalid
cast_contract.omission: omitted attribute creates no HtmlAttrs pair
cast_contract.order: specifics precede globals in reflection; HtmlAttrs/repr/DOM follows effective argument order after omissions

entity_and_dom.entity: reuse HtmlElem, HtmlAttrs, HtmlBody and static dispatcher; no entity variant
entity_and_dom.export: generic exporter preserves tag, effective attr order/values, escaping and body; single void table remains authoritative

acceptance.presence: all 43 qualified bindings present only with feature on; frame remains absent
acceptance.diagnostics: invalid positional, named, enum, bound, list and union inputs reject with public diagnostic class
acceptance.morphology: bilateral DOM equality for all 43 no-arg P1422-derived routes and frozen attribute/body cases
acceptance.route_transition: 43 routes PARTIAL -> MATCH with qualified_state MATCH

claim_boundary: Only the 43 approved table-derived constructors are covered. html.frame, other tags and general HTML parity are excluded.
